title: The Last Fig Roll
youtube_title: The Last Fig Roll | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Nils sees that a last fig roll on the wooden board will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Nils makes a smaller, even share so Dori is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
